method: bun src/main.ts build, a static server, and Playwright with Chromium: for each region the computed width (where it is fixed), height (where it is fixed), padding, margin, font size, weight, line height, letter spacing, colour, background, border, radius, shadow and gap, of the reference page and of the matching element of four pages of the site (the first page, a specification, a model page and the Packaging page), which supply the blocks the reference page has; the search dialog is measured open on both.
